newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market light test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market light test - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a light test, compared with Thursday's close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand moderate. Seller interest moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs few 70.50-71.50. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs few 70.00-71.25.
